# Dr. Abdu Rahim

> Rohingya politician and member of Parliament

- Also known as: Dr. Chit Maung
- Known for: Rohingya politician and member of Parliament
- Fields: Politics
- Page: https://people.rohingya.ro/people/abdu-rahim/

## Summary

A Rohingya political figure, also known as Dr. Chit Maung, who represented Maungdaw in the 1974 Hluttaw during the BSPP period. His election shows that Rohingya representatives still held parliamentary seats in the early years of BSPP rule.

## What he did

- **1974** — Member of the Hluttaw, representing Maungdaw.

## Biography: Maungdaw's member of the 1974 Hluttaw

Dr. Abdu Rahim, also known as Dr. Chit Maung, was a Rohingya political figure who represented Maungdaw during the BSPP period. Historical records identify him as a member of the 1974 Hluttaw, representing Maungdaw.

Rahim's political significance comes from his participation in Burma's national political system as a representative from a Rohingya-majority area. His election in 1974 demonstrates that Rohingya representatives continued to hold parliamentary positions during the early BSPP period.
